TRANSLATION OF FRENCH POLICE REPORT 15677/S DATED JANUARY 22, 1937.
---------------------------------------- [SECRET] ----------------------------------------

SUBJECT:    Division of Japanese Troops in Shanghai. Their
            protection and observation posts. Military
            offices.

REFERENCE:  Japanese Forces in Shanghai.                                            Capt C
                                                                                      Comdt S.V.C
                                                                                      - M - O - - - -
                                                                                      (illegible)

The acts of terrorism committed in Shanghai against the
Japanese military and civil population during the course of
1936 have resulted in the augmentation of the personnel of
the Landing Party in this city. In order to better protect
the lives of the Japanese residents and to safeguard Japanese
establishments, the Staff-Major of the Landing Party has
designated, in various districts, several Japanese owned
buildings to serve as protection and observation posts. These
posts, in the event of Sino-Japanese hostilities, would also
be employed as rallying points for the Japanese civil popul-
ation.

The following is information that we have gathered on the
division of the Japanese troops in Shanghai and a list of the
main protection posts:-

A. NORTHERN DISTRICT OF SHANGHAI (including northern
   region of the Outside Roads).

1. Barracks at No. 10 East Kiangwan Road.

Of the four to five thousand men garrisoned in Shanghai,
nearly four thousand are stationed at No. 10 East Kiangwan
Road in the buildings which were constructed after the events
of 1932. The Staff-Major of the Landing Party is to be
found at this address. The residence of Admiral Denjiro
OKINOMI, commander of the troops, is located at No. 1 East
Kiangwan Road.

These barracks have been built on the latest up-to-date
modern lines. They are provided with godowns for war
materials and munitions, with garages for armoured-cars,
tanks, artillery, etc....a short-wave radio station (receiving
and transmitting), with several heliograph transmitting sets,
with a small electric generator....Further, communication is

主题：    驻沪日军编制。其
            保护哨所和观察哨所。军事
            机构。

参考：    驻沪日军。                                            C 上尉
                                                                                      S.V.C 司令
                                                                                      - M - O - - - -
                                                                                      （字迹不清）

1936年间在上海针对日本军民实施的恐怖主义行为，导致驻沪海军陆战队人员增加。为了更好地保护日本居民的生命安全并保卫日本机构，海军陆战队参谋长在各区域指定了数处日资建筑作为保护和观察哨所。一旦发生中日敌对行动，这些哨所也将被用作日本平民的集结点。

以下是我们收集到的关于驻沪日军编制及主要保护哨所名单的信息：

A. 上海北区（包括外马路北部地区）。

1. 江湾东路10号兵营。

在驻沪的四五千名士兵中，近四千人驻扎在江湾东路10号，该处建筑是在1932年事变后建造的。海军陆战队参谋长即在此办公。部队指挥官奥村丹次郎（Denjiro OKINOMI，音译）海军少将的寓所位于江湾东路1号。

这些兵营是按照最新的现代化标准建造的。配有存放战争物资和弹药的仓库，停放装甲车、坦克、火炮等的车库 ____ 一个短波无线电台（收发两用），数个日光信号发射装置，一台小型发电机 ____ 此外，通讯通过

pages.en:

maintained between the barracks and the Japanese Embassy and
the offices of the Military Attache by means of special
wires.

According to information, which we have not been able to
verify, the following war supplies were to be found on the
premises of the barracks at the beginning of December:-

6 Baby tanks (very light tanks).
10 light tanks
16-18 armoured-cars
8 76 m/m field-artillery guns
8 37m/m guns
8 trench mortars (72 m/m)
4 anti-aircraft guns (76 m/m)
2 howitzers (120 m/m)
6 76 m/m guns (reserve - without personnel)
Several dozens of motor-cycles armed with machine guns.

2. Nos. 636-641 North Szechuan Road (Corner of Jukon-Tse-Road)
Buildings rented by the Japanese Authorities.

A very spacious building of four stories, these premises
are occupied by the Staff-Major of the Landing Party units
which arrived in Shanghai during September and October, 1936.
Two companies of the Marine's infantry units are stationed in
this building.

On the roof of this building, one or more machine gun nests
have been installed. This post is also an extremely fine
observation point ( it dominates the surrounding district),
and is employed as a radio-station and a heliograph sending (SIGNAL)
station.

Four armoured-cars are permanently stationed in the com-
pound of this building, in which quarters are found for the
officers of the Japanese garrison here.

The detachment stationed on these premises is responsible
for patrolling North Szechuen Road and the surrounding streets.

6辆微型坦克（超轻型坦克）。

2. 北四川路636-641号（岳州路转角）
由日本当局租用的建筑。

这是一栋非常宽敞的四层建筑，这些房屋由1936年9月和10月抵达上海的海军陆战队分队参谋长占用。两连海军陆战队步兵驻扎在这栋楼内。

在这栋楼的屋顶上，安装了一个或多个机枪巢。该哨所也是一个极佳的观察点（它俯瞰周边区域），并被用作无线电台和日光信号发送站。

四辆装甲车常驻在该建筑的院落内，院内设有在此驻防的日本军官宿舍。

驻扎在这些房舍的分队负责巡逻北四川路及周边街道。

Japanese Club. Protection and rallying post. Occupation
not permanent.

1个连（常备执勤）。

日本海军武官的车库，内停有数辆属于武官处和海军陆战队的汽车、卡车和摩托车。车间。
人员 - 1个小队（常备执勤）。

9. 号 **〔此处转录不清〕**

pages.en:
- 4 -

11. No. 128 Quinsan Road.
Offices of the Japanese Residents' Corporation. Protection
Post. Rallying point for sections of Japanese "civil guards"
and youths eligible for service in the Japanese Army. Occupation
not permanent.

12. No. 23 North Yangtse Road.
N.Y.K. Pontoon, alongside of which a Japanese Naval ship
is always lying. Depot of the Landing Party, munitions of
war are kept in this building for the Landing Party and for
ships of the Third Squadron.
This building is protected by one section of Marine infantry
which patrols Nanzing Road and by sentries at the various
crossroads in the vicinity. In case of necessity this
section can be reinforced by marines from the ship lying
alongside the N.Y.K. pontoon.

B. CHAPEI DISTRICT.

13. Japanese Brewery - Ho Kia Shih Hwa Yuan Kia (何家宅花園街)
(Behind Rokusan Gardens).
Protection post employed as an observation post.
Machine gun nests. Personnel - 1 section.

14. Rokusan Gardens.
∠ Protection Post. Occupation not permanent.

C. YANGTZEPOO DISTRICT.

15. 299 Baikal Road - 25 Fasting Road.
These two properties are adjacent and communicate with
each other. At the first address (299 Baikal Road), are
located the offices of the Japanese Naval Attache and the
godowns (concrete) for arms and ammunition. Similar
godowns were constructed in 1936 at 25 Fasting Road, where
the garages for armoured cars and tanks are situated.
pages.zh:
- 4 -

11. 昆山路128号。
日本居留民团办事处。保护哨所。日本“民间警卫队”分队及符合服兵役条件的日本青年的集结点。非永久占领。

12. 扬子江路23号。
日本邮船会社（N.Y.K.）浮码头，旁边始终停靠着一艘日本海军舰艇。海军陆战队 depot，此楼内为海军陆战队及第三舰队舰艇存放战争物资。
该建筑由一个海军陆战队步兵小队保护，该小队巡逻南京路，并在附近各个十字路口设有哨兵。如有必要，该小队可由停靠在日邮浮码头旁的舰艇上的海军陆战队队员增援。

B. 闸北区。

13. 日本啤酒厂 - 何家宅花园街（Ho Kia Shih Hwa Yuan Kia）
（六三花园后方）。
用作观察哨的保护哨所。
机枪巢。人员 - 1个小队。

14. 六三花园。
∠ 保护哨所。非永久占领。

C. 杨树浦区。

15. 贝加尔路299号 - 法斯特路25号。
这两处房产相邻且相互连通。在第一处地址（贝加尔路299号），设有日本海军武官办事处以及武器弹药的（混凝土）仓库。类似的仓库于1936年在法斯特路25号建造，那里是装甲车和坦克的车库所在地。

pages.en:

or three armoured cars and several (about ten) light tanks
are garaged there. The two buildings are lit by a small
electric generator installed at No. 23 Laoting Road. The
place is protected by 1-2 groups of Marine infantry.

16. No. 83 - 139, Lane 541, Glen Road.
Quarters of the employees of the Japanese Dah Keng Cotton
Mill. Protection and rallying post. Machine guns, armed
motor-cycles. Observation post. Personnel - 2 - 3 sections,
perhaps one company (always on duty).
This detachment is responsible for the patrolling of that
district in the vicinity of the quarters.

17. No. 1603 Pingliang Road.
Quarters of the employees of the No. 2 and No. 3 Mills
of the Shanghai Cotton Manufacturing Company.
Protection post.
Machine guns, observation post. Personnel - 1 - 2
sections (always on duty).

18. No. 227 Zhongxing Road.
Quarters of the employees of the No. 2 mill of the Kung
Dah Cotton Filature.
Protection post.
Observation post, heliograph signalling apparatus,
machine guns. 2 sections - 1 company - perhaps more
(always on duty).
This detachment is responsible for the patrolling of the
district in the vicinity of its quarters. It holds its
exercises on the grounds of the Japanese School, 2105 Ping-
liang Road.

19. No. 184 Yangtzepoo Road (G.S.L. Dept).
Depot for war material (disembarking point for Japanese
transports). 1 - 2 sections of Marine infantry protect this
point, which is also guarded by patrols in the vicinity of the
**〔此处转录不清〕**

那里停放着两到三辆装甲车和数辆（约十辆）轻型坦克。这两座建筑由安装在劳亭路23号的一台小型发电机供电。该地由1-2组海军陆战队步兵保护。

16. 格兰路541弄83-139号。
日本大康纱厂员工宿舍。保护和集结哨所。机枪，武装摩托车。观察哨。人员 - 2-3个小队，或许一个连（常备执勤）。
该分队负责巡逻宿舍附近的区域。

17. 平凉路1603号。
上海棉纺织公司第二、第三厂员工宿舍。

机枪，观察哨。人员 - 1-2个小队（常备执勤）。

18. 中兴路227号。
公大纱厂第二厂员工宿舍。
保护哨所。
观察哨，日光信号装置，机枪。2个小队 - 1个连 - 或许更多（常备执勤）。
该分队负责巡逻其宿舍附近的区域。他们在平凉路2105号日本学校的场地上进行演习。

19. 杨树浦路184号（工务局）。
战争物资仓库（日本运输船卸货点）。1-2个海军陆战队步兵小队保护此点，该点也由 **〔此处转录不清〕** 附近的巡逻队守卫

The grounds of the school are employed for exercises by

Nagai Wata Kaisha employees' club.
Protection post.
Wooden observation post. Heliograph signalling apparatus.
Rallying point for reservists residing in the western
district.
Personnel - 1 company (always on duty).

27. No. 58 - 60 Singapore Road.
Kung Dah No. 3 Mill.
Designated as a protection post.
Occupation not permanent.

28. No. 601 Kiaochow Road.
Western district Japanese Primary School.
Rallying point.
Occupation not permanent.

29. No. 14 - 19 West Soochow Road.
Nagai Wata Kaisha No. 6 and No. 7 Mills.
Designated as protection posts.
Observation post. It appears that an armoured cement
platform for the use of artillery has been constructed here
recently.
Non-permanent occupation.

30. No. 62 Bohiam Road.
Nagai Wata Kaisha No. 1 and No. 2 Mills.
Designated as a protection post.
Wooden observation post.
Non-permanent occupation.

**〔此处转录不清〕**

Truthfully speaking there are no protection posts on the
right bank of the Whangpoo. In case of necessity, however,
Japanese vessels would probably proceed to the wharves of
Japanese concerns on the Pootung side:

N.J.K. Wharf, Pei Wo Tang Lou (北博塘路).
H.Y.L. Wharf, Shi Wa Kien (十五间).
S.K.B Wharf, Lao Pa Tsu (老白渡).
pages.zh:

26. 戈登路936号。
永泰纱厂（Nagai Wata Kaisha）员工俱乐部。
保护哨所。
木制观察哨。日光信号装置。
居住在西区的后备役人员集结点。
人员 - 1个连（常备执勤）。

27. 新加坡路58-60号。
公大第三厂。
被指定为保护哨所。
非永久占领。

28. 胶州路601号。
西区日本小学。
集结点。
非永久占领。

29. 西苏州路14-19号。
永泰纱厂第六、第七厂。
被指定为保护哨所。
观察哨。似乎最近在此处建造了一个供火炮使用的装甲混凝土平台。
非永久占领。

30. 波赫姆路62号。
永泰纱厂第一、第二厂。
被指定为保护哨所。
木制观察哨。
非永久占领。

**〔此处转录不清〕**

如实说来，黄浦江右岸没有保护哨所。然而，如有必要，日本船只可能会驶往浦东一侧日资企业的码头：

日本邮船会社（N.J.K.）码头，北博塘路。
华阳轮船公司（H.Y.L.）码头，十五间。
S.K.B 码头，老白渡。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Int. N & B. REGISTRY
Special Branch S.1. 4710
Date April 1, 1933

Subject (in full) List of places where members of the Japanese Naval
Landing Party are stationed.

Made by D. C. Imamura. Forwarded by Tho Robertson, Supt

In accordance with the instructions of the Officer
i/c Special Branch, I forward herewith a list of places in
Shanghai where members of the Japanese Naval Special Landing Party
are stationed:-

Corner of North Szechuen Road and ..... Headquarters Staff,
Kiangwan Road 1st Battalion and
4th Battalion.

Toyoda Cotton Mill, .................... 1st and 2nd Company,
No. 200 Jessfield Road. 2nd Battalion.

N.W.K. Suigetsu Club,................... 3rd Company, 2nd
No. 102 Gordon Road. Battalion.

Kung Dah No.2 Mill Quarters,............ 1st and 2nd Company,
No. 227 Wahsin Road. 3rd Battalion.

Dah Kong Mill Quarters,................. 3rd Company, 3rd
No. 542 Glen Road. Battalion.

D. C. Imamura

Officer i/c Special Branch.
File
（批：APP）
